subject: Having difficulty with making the input interactive

messages.author: 0f321e852719be86
messages.subject: Having difficulty with making the input interactive
parts:
Hello

I am a beginner and having difficulty making the bubble chart respond to inputs

I have an example dataset in the 'app.r' below called dF.

Thanks in advance for any help!!!

sanjeev



library(shiny)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)




dF<-data.frame(
  id=c("26807712", "26794930", "26518434","26847041","26504153", "26824982", "26773072", "26757162", "26810136", "26781275"),
  date=c("2016-01-26","2016-01-22","2016-01-15","2016-02-05","2015-12-19","2016-01-29","2016-01-16", "2016-01-12","2016-01-26", "2016-01-19"),
  score=c(1.23, 8.00,  0.03, 1.23, 1.10, 0.97, 5.20, 9.50, 2.40,1.98),
  rank=c(12.5, 10.3, 45.5, 3.6, 8.3, 1.4, 13.1, 7.0, 0.7, 7.1),
  class=c("OBS","RCT","GEN","META","RCT","DIA","OBS" ,"META","GEN","DIA"))





ui<-fluidPage(
  
  titlePanel(title="Interactive Bubble Chart"),
  
  sidebarLayout(
    
    sidebarPanel(
      ### Input for Impact
      sliderInput("impact","Choose an Impact", min=min(dF$rank), max=max(dF$rank), value=c(10,20)),
      
      ## Input for Method
      selectInput("method", "Choose a Methodology",choices=as.character(dF$class), multiple = T)
      
      
      
      
    ),
    
    
    mainPanel(
      plotOutput("plot"),
      textOutput("text1")
      
      
      
    )
    
  )
  
  
)

server<-function(input, output){
  
  inputData<-reactive({
    
    input$impact<-dF$rank
    input$method<-dF$class
    
    
  })
  
  
  
  
  output$plot<-renderPlot({
    

   ##  My bubble chart is not produced with this line of code
   ## ggplot(dF,aes(date,score,colour=input$method, size=input$impact)) + geom_point() + ylim(-1,10)
   
   ##  this line of code produces the bubble chart I want but it is not responding to change in inputs 
    ggplot(dF,aes(date,score,colour=class, size=rank)) + geom_point() + ylim(-1,10)
   
    
  })
  
  
  
  output$text1<-renderText({
    
    paste("You have selected this", input$methodology)
    
  })
  
  

}


shinyApp(ui=ui, server=server)

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Having difficulty with making the input interactive
parts:
You need a reactive expression to represent the subsetted data.

subsetted <- reactive({
  dF %>%
    filter(rank >= input$impact[1] & rank <= input$impact[2]) %>%
    filter(class == input$method)
})

Then, the first argument to ggplot() needs to change from `dF` to `subsetted()`.
